rationales.Alabama: Alabama's blistering ceiling is underscored by dominant multi-score victories over LSU and South Carolina, offsetting a tight loss to Georgia.

rationales.Indiana: Indiana plays sharp, efficient football with their only defeats coming in one-possession heartbreakers against Ohio State and Washington.

rationales.Iowa: Iowa's 8-2 Big Ten résumé features wins over Michigan, Wisconsin, Illinois, and Northwestern, earning the benefit of the doubt despite its Ohio State loss.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 record, elite 31.3 SP+ and wins over Alabama, Florida and Ole Miss make it the strongest complete résumé in the packet.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 finish, 23.1 SP+ and quality wins over USC, Nebraska and Michigan justify an elite Big Ten placement.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 7-3 campaign features wins over Ohio State, USC, Nebraska and Michigan, giving it the strongest Big Ten strength of schedule.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State's 24.1 SP+ and wins over Iowa, Indiana and Illinois offset losses to Oregon, USC, Texas and Nebraska.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa's 8-2 record and wins over Michigan, Wisconsin, Washington and Illinois support a top-six ranking despite its loss to Ohio State.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 record, 21.1 SP+ and eight notable wins make it a deserving top-eight team with only a narrow loss to Michigan.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 record, 25.6 SP+ and eight notable wins support an elite ranking despite its narrow loss to BYU.
rationales.Texas: Texas's 9-2 record and wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, Missouri and LSU pair a strong offense with quality opposition.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 record, 22.9 SP+ and wins over Kentucky, LSU, Florida State and South Carolina show a high-level résumé.
rationales.Utah: Utah's 10-0 record, 21.7 SP+ and wins over BYU, Houston, Arizona and Arkansas make it the packet's only undefeated team.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 record, 24.4 SP+ and eight notable wins place it near the top despite a close loss to Notre Dame.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 8-2 record, 21.5 SP+ and wins over Alabama, Auburn, LSU and Arkansas make it a strong top-12 choice.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with a head-to-head win at Alabama plus wins over Ole Miss, Florida, Missouri, and Oklahoma, and its lone loss (Auburn) does not offset that body of work.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated at 10-0 with quality wins over BYU, Houston, Arizona, Cincinnati, and Iowa State, though the committee notes some uncertainty about the depth of its schedule.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with a win over Ohio State and victories over Tennessee, Ole Miss, LSU, and Missouri, with its two losses (Oklahoma, Florida) both competitive.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 with wins over LSU, Florida State, Texas A&M, and South Carolina, and its two losses (Georgia, Tennessee) came against ranked-caliber opponents.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with its only loss to Notre Dame, and wins over Florida State, Clemson, and Wake Forest support a top-five profile.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with its only loss a close road game at BYU, and wins over Miami, Wisconsin, and SMU; the committee acknowledges some uncertainty in its independent schedule.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with a win over USC and a narrow loss to Ohio State, though the Washington loss and softer non-conference slate temper its ceiling.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a home win over Alabama plus Auburn and LSU victories, offset by losses to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over Notre Dame and wins over Arizona, Arizona State, and Baylor, with losses to Utah and UCF.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State, and Arizona State, and its only loss came at Cincinnati.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a head-to-head win at Oregon, though its overall schedule strength is lighter than the teams above it.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a road win over Louisville and dominant wins over SMU, Virginia, and Stanford, with its only loss to Miami.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia has the strongest body of work in the packet, with wins at Alabama and at Ole Miss plus a neutral-site win over Florida, and its lone loss to Auburn is the only blemish; I note some uncertainty because the Auburn result is a genuine data point against them.
rationales.Utah: Utah is the only unbeaten team here and swept BYU, Houston, and Arizona head-to-head, though I acknowledge its schedule proxy is modest and the margins in those wins were sometimes thin.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 record includes a road win at Wake Forest and a road rout of Clemson, with the only loss a close one at Notre Dame, so the head-to-head defeat keeps them below the Irish's conquerors rather than above.
rationales.Texas: Texas holds wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, and LSU, and its two losses are close ones to Oklahoma and Florida, which I weigh as a strong but not flawless resume.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a win over Miami and a neutral-site win over Wisconsin, but the head-to-head loss at BYU is the reason I cannot place the Irish above the Cougars despite the better record.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's wins over USC, Nebraska, Michigan, and Northwestern are solid, and its two losses are close, though I am uncertain how much to credit the Michigan win given Michigan's own uneven profile.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame and Arizona head-to-head and owns a road win at TCU, but the road loss at Utah and the UCF defeat keep the Cougars behind the Utes and the top group.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with head-to-head wins over Houston and Arizona and a road win at Oklahoma State, and the lone loss at Cincinnati is the main reason I hold them below BYU.
rationales.Ole Miss: Ole Miss has quality wins over Louisville, LSU, Missouri, and Auburn, but four losses including a lopsided one to Georgia and a road loss at Florida make this a genuinely uncertain placement.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's wins at LSU and at Kentucky plus a home win over Texas A&M are strong, but the head-to-head losses to Georgia and Tennessee are decisive in keeping the Tide below both.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee beat Alabama head-to-head and owns wins over LSU, Auburn, and Kentucky, but the home loss to Texas and the road loss at South Carolina are real negatives I cannot ignore.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win at Oregon and wins over Wisconsin and Illinois, though the loss at Michigan and a relatively thin schedule proxy leave me uncertain whether this is too low.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia dominates on the field with crushing blowouts over Missouri, South Carolina, and Ole Miss alongside a marquee road win at Alabama.
rationales.Utah: Utah remains an undefeated powerhouse, displaying balanced control and clutch grit in big wins over BYU, Arizona, and Arkansas.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame looks like an absolute juggernaut, blowing out quality opponents while claiming a convincing 31-24 victory over Miami.
rationales.Miami: Miami passes the visual test with flying colors, boasting emphatic blowouts over Clemson and Wake Forest.
rationales.Texas: Texas has shown elite form in tough road wins at Tennessee and against Ohio State, despite a couple of tight slip-ups.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA controls games on both sides of the ball, highlighted by a signature road triumph over Oregon and complete defensive suffocation of Maryland.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama displays staggering offensive explosion with 45-plus points in four separate SEC matchups, only falling in close battles.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee looks dominant when firing, evidenced by double-digit physical beatdowns of Alabama, LSU, and Kentucky.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech's explosive offense has shredded defenses in high-scoring routs over West Virginia and Arizona State.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana looks remarkably sharp with a decisive 27-13 victory over USC and relentless offensive consistency.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest dismantled ACC competition with four separate 30-plus point blowouts and a gutsy road win over Louisville.
rationales.BYU: BYU owns high-quality, impressive victories over Notre Dame and Arizona while controlling games effectively on both fronts.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 70-20 rout of Western Kentucky and 42-7 win at Ole Miss show dominant margins, with only a close home loss to Auburn.
rationales.Texas: Texas won late at Ohio State and beat Florida and Ole Miss, showing tight wins against quality SEC opponents.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State's road wins at Iowa and Indiana were close, but its 28-41 home loss to Oregon is a notable blemish.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's road win over Ohio State and 41-27 win at USC showed consistent margins against Big Ten opponents.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana beat Ohio State 19-15 on the road and USC 27-13, with its only loss a close one at Washington.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 24-31 loss to Notre Dame was close, but its wins at Clemson, Florida State, and Wake Forest were convincing.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 41-13 win over Wisconsin and 58-7 blowout of Stanford stand out, though its loss at BYU was narrow.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 20-17 loss to Georgia and 10-26 loss at Tennessee were close, but wins over LSU and Florida State were solid.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten with road wins at Arizona (40-39) and Cincinnati (49-25), though its margins against Big 12 opponents were often narrow.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a 17-15 road win at Oregon, but its only loss was a close one at Michigan.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech won 53-25 over Arizona State and 53-48 over West Virginia, showing offensive firepower in close and blowout games.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 26-10 win over Alabama and 34-6 rout of Kentucky show strong play in its best wins, with a loss to South Carolina.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1, with wins over Alabama, Florida, and Ole Miss, and its only loss came narrowly to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0 and has beaten BYU, Arizona, and Houston, despite a less imposing listed schedule profile than Georgia.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's strong 7-3 record includes wins over Ohio State, USC, and Boise State, while its losses include UCLA and Illinois.
rationales.Texas: Texas has wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, and Ole Miss, but its 9-2 record includes losses to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a road win over Wake Forest and victories over Clemson and Florida State; Notre Dame beat Miami head-to-head.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 resume features wins over Miami and SMU, with its only loss a close road result at BYU.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 and owns the direct win over Oregon, with victories over Illinois and Wisconsin and a narrow loss at Michigan.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's wins over Alabama and LSU stand out, though its losses to Texas and South Carolina keep it below the stronger one-loss resumes.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama has an 8-2 record and quality wins over Florida State, LSU, and Texas A&M, but lost to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Arizona, Houston, and Arizona State; its loss to Cincinnati is a significant blemish.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with wins over USC, Michigan, and Nebraska, but its loss to Ohio State and defeat at Washington weigh against a higher slot.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest's 9-1 mark includes a decisive win over SMU and road wins over Louisville and NC State, but Miami beat it head-to-head.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia stays No. 1 with a 9-1 mark, wins over Alabama, Florida, Oklahoma and Ole Miss, and its lone loss is a one-point home upset to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with head-to-head wins over BYU, Houston and Arizona plus a 43-10 rout of Arkansas, keeping it at No. 2.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 resume includes wins over LSU, Texas A&M, South Carolina and Florida State, with narrow losses only to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win over Oregon and wins against Wisconsin, Illinois and Minnesota, its only loss a two-point defeat at Michigan.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss and LSU, and its two losses came by a combined six points.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with wins over Miami, Wisconsin and SMU, its only blemish a four-point road loss to BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a win over Notre Dame and dominant ACC victories over Clemson, Pittsburgh and Florida State.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with a win over USC and road wins at Nebraska and Michigan, with both losses by a combined eight points to Ohio State and Washington.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over Alabama plus wins over Auburn, LSU and Kentucky, losing only close games to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with a win over Notre Dame and victories over Arizona, Arizona State and Iowa State, losing to Utah and UCF.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a road win over Louisville and blowouts of SMU, Virginia and Stanford, its only loss to Miami.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State and Arizona State, its lone loss a road upset at Cincinnati.

rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with no listed loss, an FBS SOS proxy of .480, and wins over BYU, Houston, and Arizona; its SP+ is 21.7.
rationales.Georgia: Georgia combines a 9-1 record with the packet’s highest SP+ and FPI, plus road wins over Alabama and Ole Miss.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with strong SP+ and FPI, including wins over Clemson and Wake Forest, though Notre Dame beat it head-to-head.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1, has the strongest FPI among these one-loss teams, and beat Miami, while its BYU loss keeps it below the undefeated teams.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana’s 8-2 record includes wins over USC, Michigan, and Nebraska, and its SP+ and FPI are excellent; it narrowly lost at home to Ohio State.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with a strong .588 SOS proxy and wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, and Ole Miss, offset by losses to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee’s 8-2 includes a decisive win over Alabama and another over LSU, while its two losses were narrow defeats to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama’s 8-2 profile has high SP+, FPI, and .530 SOS, but losses to Georgia and Tennessee temper its placement.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with high efficiency ratings and wins over Louisville and SMU, but its home loss to Miami and .430 SOS proxy weigh against it.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon has wins over Ohio State, USC, and Boise State and a .609 SOS proxy, but its three losses—including to UCLA—lower its standing.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win over Oregon and a 21.1 SP+, but the .438 SOS proxy and limited top-end wins place it below the stronger schedules.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with an 19.4 SP+ and wins over Arizona and Houston, but its .470 SOS proxy and loss to Cincinnati constrain its rank.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia leads the packet on SP+ (31.3) and FPI (28.7) with a 9-1 record and a signature road win at Alabama.
rationales.Texas: Texas combines FPI 25.4 and SP+ 22.4 with a road win at Florida-adjacent quality and a home win over Ohio State, offsetting a close loss to Florida.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's SP+ of 22.9 and FPI of 24.2 are strong, but two losses to Georgia and Tennessee cap its ranking.
rationales.Miami: Miami has the top ACC metrics here (SP+ 24.4, FPI 24.3) and a 9-1 record, with a road win at Florida State and a 7-point loss at Notre Dame as its only major blemish.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's SP+ of 25.6 and FPI of 27.2 are elite, and its 10-1 record includes a win over Miami and a road win at North Carolina.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's SP+ (23.1) and FPI (20.8) trail only the top tier, and an 8-2 record with a win at Michigan and a home win over USC supports its position.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State's SP+ of 24.1 is high, but a 7-4 record with losses to Texas, USC and Oregon weakens the resume.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with a moderate SP+ of 21.7 and FPI of 19.4, though its best wins are less dominant by margin than the top teams.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with SP+ 19.4 and FPI 17.1, and its only loss is a road game at Cincinnati.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with SP+ 21.1 and FPI 12.6, anchored by a road win at Oregon, though its loss at Michigan is a concern.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee has SP+ 21.5 and FPI 19.1 with road wins at Texas A&M and Georgia Tech, but home losses to Kentucky-level opponents are not present; its 8-2 record is solid.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with SP+ 22.6 and FPI 20.2, but its schedule-adjusted resume is weaker than the teams above it.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia holds the top spot boasting a pristine resume with nation-leading FPI (28.68) and SP+ (31.3) alongside elite wins over Alabama, Florida, and Ole Miss.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated at 10-0 with top-15 metrics across the board and head-to-head resume wins over BYU, Arizona, and Houston.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame sits at 10-1 with a dominant top-three SP+ (25.6) and FPI (27.21) profile paired with a marquee win over Miami.
rationales.Miami: Miami owns a sterling 9-1 record supported by elite top-five metrics in both SP+ (24.4) and FPI (24.28) with high-efficiency victories.
rationales.Texas: Texas features a robust 0.588 SOS proxy and top-six predictive ratings, underpinned by quality victories over Ohio State and Tennessee.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama maintains top-tier power ratings (24.21 FPI, 22.9 SP+) and seven high-level SEC wins against a grueling schedule.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana excels in efficiency metrics (23.1 SP+, 20.77 FPI) with an 8-2 record including a convincing head-to-head victory over USC.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee combines an 8-2 record with a top-ten SP+ (21.5) and an elite signature win over Alabama.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA boasts a 10-1 record with strong efficiency markers (21.1 SP+) and a crucial head-to-head road triumph over Oregon.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with top-ten caliber efficiency numbers (22.6 SP+, 20.16 FPI) and a quality road victory at Louisville.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech possesses an outstanding 9-1 mark backed by strong predictive metrics (19.4 SP+) and head-to-head wins over Arizona and Houston.
rationales.BYU: BYU secures the final playoff spot at 8-2, justified by top-twenty metrics and top-tier victories over Notre Dame and Arizona.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia owns the best win profile in the packet, beating Alabama on the road, Ole Miss by 35 away, and Florida by 19 on a neutral field with only a three-point home loss to Auburn.
rationales.Texas: Texas beat Ohio State, Tennessee away, Ole Miss, LSU away and Missouri, with both losses coming by three points to Florida and Oklahoma.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's road wins at Kentucky, LSU, Mississippi State and Vanderbilt plus a 50-36 win over Florida State outweigh narrow losses to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee beat Alabama 26-10, Kentucky 34-6, LSU, Auburn, Texas A&M away and Georgia Tech away, with only a three-point loss to Texas and a road loss at South Carolina.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with wins over BYU, Houston, Arizona away, Cincinnati away, TCU and Iowa State, so the unbeaten record earns a top-five spot despite a thinner schedule proxy.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with road wins at Wake Forest, Clemson, Stanford and a home win over Duke, its lone loss a 31-24 decision at Notre Dame.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 mark includes a win over Miami and a neutral-site win over Wisconsin, with the only loss a four-point road defeat at BYU.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana beat USC and Nebraska and Michigan on the road plus Northwestern and Minnesota, and its two losses are by four to Ohio State and three at Washington.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame and Arizona at home, TCU and Kansas on the road, and Arizona State, with losses to Utah and UCF.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a road win over Louisville, road wins at NC State, California and Georgia Tech, and its lone loss a 33-20 home defeat to Miami.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State away, Baylor away and Arizona State, the lone loss a 37-24 road defeat at Cincinnati.
rationales.Ole Miss: Ole Miss has quality wins over Louisville on a neutral field, Missouri, Auburn and LSU, but four losses including a 42-7 home defeat to Georgia keep it here.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with head-to-head wins over Alabama, Florida, and Ole Miss plus a 42-7 demolition of Ole Miss, the strongest SEC body of work in the packet.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 with a deep quality-win list including LSU, Texas A&M, South Carolina, Florida State, and a 45-17 road win over Kentucky; the two losses are to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, LSU, and Missouri, and its losses to Oklahoma and Florida are narrow.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over Alabama plus Auburn, LSU, and Kentucky wins, and only one-score losses to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with wins over BYU, Arizona, Houston, and Iowa State, an unblemished record that earns a top-four slot despite a lighter Big 12 slate.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a win over Miami and blowouts of Stanford, SMU, and Wisconsin, with its only loss a tight one at BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a 41-13 win at Clemson and a win over Wake Forest, its lone loss a four-point road game at Notre Dame.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over USC and road wins at Nebraska and Michigan; both losses were one-score games against Ohio State and Washington.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with dominant wins over SMU, Stanford, Virginia, and Louisville, its only loss to Miami.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with head-to-head wins over Houston and Arizona plus road wins at Oklahoma State and Oregon State.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with head-to-head wins over Arizona and Notre Dame, though the UCF loss and Utah defeat temper its profile.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon is 7-3 but its wins include Ohio State, USC, and Boise State, and its three losses were all by one score or less in a brutal Big Ten slate.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 résumé includes wins over Alabama, Florida, Oklahoma, Ole Miss and Missouri, with only a narrow loss to Auburn.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 7-3 Big Ten résumé features wins over Ohio State, USC, Nebraska and Michigan, giving it the strongest Big Ten case for a top-four seed.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA went 10-1 with a major upset of Oregon and convincing wins over Wisconsin, Illinois, Maryland and Michigan State.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 season includes wins over USC, Nebraska, Michigan and Northwestern, though the loss to Ohio State prevents perfection.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State remains elite at 7-4 with wins over Iowa, Indiana, Illinois and Northwestern, despite losses to Oregon, USC, Texas and Nebraska.
rationales.Texas: Texas went 9-2 with quality wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, Missouri and LSU, narrowly losing only to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Utah: Utah's unbeaten 10-0 campaign includes wins over BYU, Arizona, Cincinnati and Arkansas, with no notable losses.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 record features dominant wins over Wisconsin, Stanford, Michigan State and Boston College, with BYU its only loss.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 8-2 résumé includes wins over Alabama, Auburn, LSU and Kentucky, losing narrowly to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.BYU: BYU went 8-2 with wins over Notre Dame, Arizona, Baylor and Iowa State, while losses to Utah and UCF prevent perfection.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech's 9-1 season is powered by wins over Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State, Arizona State and Baylor.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 record includes convincing wins over Stanford, Clemson, Pittsburgh and Florida State, with its loss at Notre Dame.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 body of work features wins over Alabama, Florida, Ole Miss, Oklahoma, Arkansas and Missouri, with only a narrow loss to Auburn.
rationales.Texas: Texas pairs a 9-2 record with quality victories over Ohio State, Tennessee, LSU, Ole Miss, Missouri and Mississippi State, plus a close neutral-site loss to Oklahoma.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's Big Ten strength of schedule and wins over Ohio State, USC, Nebraska, Michigan and Michigan State make it a compelling résumé despite three losses.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 season includes a win over Miami and quality wins over Wisconsin, Stanford, Boston College and Michigan State, with only a loss to BYU.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 Big Ten résumé features wins over Oregon, Wisconsin, Illinois, Maryland and Michigan State, plus a narrow loss to Michigan.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's eight wins include Kentucky, South Carolina, LSU, Florida State, Mississippi State and Texas A&M, though losses to Georgia and Tennessee expose its ceiling.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated at 10-0 with wins over BYU, Arizona, Arkansas, Cincinnati and Houston, giving it the cleanest record in the field.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 Big Ten season includes wins over USC, Nebraska, Michigan, Northwestern, Minnesota and Rutgers, with a close loss to Ohio State.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State remains a strong Big Ten contender at 7-4, boasting wins over Iowa, Indiana, Illinois and Northwestern despite losses to Oregon, USC, Nebraska and Texas.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa's 8-2 record and wins over Michigan, Wisconsin, Northwestern, Illinois and Washington support a strong Big Ten case despite its loss to Ohio State.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 résumé features wins over Wake Forest, Clemson, Duke, Stanford, Pittsburgh and Florida State, with its only loss to Notre Dame.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech's 9-1 record includes wins over Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State, Oregon State, Arizona State and Baylor, with one loss to Cincinnati.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with wins over Alabama, Florida, Ole Miss and Missouri; the lone Auburn loss is the only blemish on the strongest SEC body of work, though I acknowledge some uncertainty about one-score outcomes.
rationales.Utah: Utah is a perfect 10-0 with wins over BYU, Arizona, Houston, Iowa State and TCU, giving the Utes the cleanest resume in the packet even if its schedule strength is debatable.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss and LSU; the Oklahoma and Florida losses are real, but the quality wins lead the SEC's second tier.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 with a deep win list (LSU, Texas A&M, South Carolina, Florida State, Kentucky); losses to Georgia and Tennessee are the only negatives on an otherwise top-tier profile.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a win over Miami and dominant victories over Wisconsin, SMU and Stanford; the BYU loss keeps it out of the very top, and I note the independent schedule's unevenness.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with its only loss coming at Notre Dame, plus wins over Clemson, Florida State and Pittsburgh; the ACC body of work is strong but slightly thinner than the teams above.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with wins over USC, Michigan and Nebraska; the Ohio State and Washington losses are both narrow, keeping the Hoosiers firmly in the at-large conversation.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with wins over Alabama, Auburn, Kentucky and LSU; losses to Texas and South Carolina are the only marks against a resume that compares closely with Alabama's.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a head-to-head win over Oregon and wins over Wisconsin, Illinois and Minnesota; the Michigan loss is the lone blemish, though the overall schedule strength carries some uncertainty.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with a notable win over Notre Dame plus Arizona, Arizona State and Iowa State; losses to Utah and UCF temper an otherwise strong Big 12 profile.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with its only loss to Miami, and wins over Louisville, SMU and Virginia; the Demon Deacons' ratings are strong but the schedule is lighter than the teams above.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston, Arizona, Arizona State and Oklahoma State; the Cincinnati loss is the lone defeat on a Big 12 profile that sits just behind the contenders.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia has the strongest on-field profile in the packet: wins over Alabama, Florida, and Ole Miss, with only a narrow home loss to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is the only unbeaten candidate and swept BYU, Arizona, and Houston head-to-head, though its schedule strength leaves some uncertainty.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a road win at Wake Forest and a dominant win at Clemson, its only loss a seven-point road game at Notre Dame.
rationales.Texas: Texas holds head-to-head wins over Tennessee, Ohio State, and Ole Miss, offset by losses to Florida and Oklahoma that keep it from the top spot.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a win over Miami, but its best result on the road at BYU went the other way, so I cannot place it above the Hurricanes.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a road win over Louisville and lopsided wins over Virginia, SMU, and Stanford; the home loss to Miami is the main blemish.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's only losses are close ones to Ohio State and Washington, and its home win over USC plus a road win at Michigan stand out.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee beat Alabama and Kentucky and won at Texas A&M, but the home loss to Texas and the road loss at South Carolina hold it below the Hoosiers.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame and Arizona head-to-head but the road loss at Utah and the UCF defeat leave it behind the one-loss contenders.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Arizona and Houston, and its lone loss at Cincinnati is the main reason it sits outside the top group.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon beat Ohio State and USC but the home loss to UCLA and road losses to Oklahoma State and Illinois create real doubt about its consistency.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win at Oregon, though the overall schedule is thinner and the loss to Michigan was narrow; I note uncertainty here.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia looks dominant on the field, posting blowout victories over Missouri, Arkansas, and South Carolina alongside a crucial road win at Alabama.
rationales.Utah: Utah remains a pristine 10-0 with emphatic double-digit victories and clutch performances like the thrilling 40-39 road victory at Arizona.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame passes every test with crushing blowouts of Wisconsin, Stanford, and Purdue, plus a marquee 31-24 victory against Miami.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama continues to look like an elite powerhouse with 45-plus point offensive outputs against Kentucky, South Carolina, and Mississippi State.
rationales.Texas: Texas demonstrates elite poise with road wins at Tennessee and Missouri, alongside a decisive 59-7 blowout over Texas State.
rationales.Miami: Miami displays explosive offensive firepower with resounding 40-plus point routs of Clemson, Stanford, Pittsburgh, and Central Michigan.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA boasts a sterling 10-1 record highlighted by a signature road triumph at Oregon and a punishing 54-3 dismantling of Maryland.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest looks devastatingly sharp in ACC play, routing Stanford, Virginia, and SMU while notching a gutsy road win over Louisville.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee controls games physically, showcased in decisive multi-score victories over Alabama, Kentucky, and Georgia Tech.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech scores at will across the Big 12, amassing over 50 points in three separate contests including a dominant 52-27 win at Oklahoma State.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana passes the visual test with an 8-2 record featuring a commanding 27-13 win over USC and a 47-15 demolition of Rutgers.
rationales.BYU: BYU controls tempo well and owns impressive physical wins over Notre Dame, Arizona, and Iowa State.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 70-20 rout of Western Kentucky, 42-7 win at Ole Miss and 27-8 neutral-site win over Florida show dominance with few close calls, despite a late 24-27 loss to Auburn.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 58-7 win over Stanford, 49-10 over Purdue and 41-13 rout of Wisconsin show it winning by large margins, with a clean 24-28 loss only at BYU.
rationales.Texas: Texas beat Ohio State 24-23, Florida 27-24 and Ole Miss 34-27 in close, grinding wins, and its only losses came in tight games to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 48-10 and 56-23 blowouts and 49-18 win over South Carolina look strong, but a 17-20 home loss to Georgia and a 10-26 loss at Tennessee cap its résumé.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with every win by a single score or moderate margin, including 40-39 at Arizona and 28-20 over BYU, but it has played a lighter overall slate.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 52-3 win over Central Michigan, 52-23 over Pittsburgh and 43-35 over Florida State show convincing wins, with a 24-31 loss at Notre Dame the only blemish.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State lost 23-24 at Texas and 18-30 at USC, but it won convincingly over Illinois, Maryland and Iowa and blew out lesser opponents.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with its only loss at Cincinnati, and its wins over Houston, Arizona and Oklahoma State were all within reach but dependable.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 52-16 and 38-0 wins and 47-15 win over Rutgers show power, but the 15-19 loss to Ohio State and tight wins over Nebraska and Michigan lower its ceiling.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 record is anchored by 17-15 at Oregon and 54-3 over Maryland, but its 16-18 loss at Michigan offers little margin for error.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 26-10 win over Alabama, 34-6 over Kentucky and 27-13 over LSU look physical, offset by a 20-17 home win over Texas and a loss to South Carolina.
rationales.Boise State: Boise State's 38-20 over Memphis and 46-41 over Oregon State show it can win shootouts, but a 20-22 home loss to San Diego State weakens its case.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 record includes road wins over Alabama and Ole Miss, and its only loss was a narrow home defeat to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0, with wins over BYU, Arizona, Houston and Iowa State and no notable losses.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a strong schedule, wins over Clemson and Wake Forest, and its sole defeat came at Notre Dame.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 record features a decisive win over Miami and a strong set of victories, though BYU handed it a close loss.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 mark and road win at Oregon stand out, with the narrow road loss at Michigan its only blemish.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss and LSU, but its losses to Oklahoma and Florida temper that résumé.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's wins over Ohio State, USC and Boise State are impressive, although losses to UCLA, Illinois and Oklahoma State leave it behind the leading records.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 and owns a home win over Alabama, with additional wins over LSU and Texas A&M; losses to Texas and South Carolina count against it.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana has an 8-2 record, including wins over USC, Michigan and Nebraska, but fell at home to Ohio State and on the road to Washington.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with wins over Notre Dame, Arizona and Iowa State, while losses to Utah and UCF limit its standing.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 and has beaten Arizona, Houston and Arizona State, but its road loss at Cincinnati is a significant setback.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with convincing wins over SMU and Louisville, but its home loss to Miami and comparatively modest schedule place it below the strongest résumés.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with a head-to-head win at Alabama, a neutral-site rout of Florida, and a 42-7 handling of Ole Miss; the lone Auburn loss is the only blemish on the packet's best resume.

rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with a win over Ohio State, a road win at Tennessee, and wins over Ole Miss and LSU; the Oklahoma and Florida losses are the only negatives.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 with quality wins over LSU, Florida State, Texas A&M, and South Carolina, though the home Georgia loss and Tennessee defeat temper the resume.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win at Oregon and wins over Wisconsin, Illinois, and Minnesota; the one-point Michigan loss is the lone setback.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a win over Miami and dominant wins over Wisconsin, Stanford, and SMU; the BYU loss is the only blemish.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a road win at Clemson, a win over Florida State, and a head-to-head win over Wake Forest; the Notre Dame loss is its only defeat.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over USC and wins at Nebraska and Michigan; the narrow Ohio State and Washington losses are explainable.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a win over Alabama and victories over Auburn, Kentucky, and LSU; the Texas and South Carolina losses are narrow.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over Notre Dame plus wins over Arizona, Arizona State, and Iowa State; losses to Utah and UCF hold it just outside the top eight.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a road win over Louisville and blowouts of SMU, Virginia, and Stanford; the Miami loss is the lone blemish on an otherwise strong ACC run.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State, and Arizona State; the Cincinnati loss is the only setback.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia pairs a 9-1 record and the packet's top SP+ (31.3) and FPI (28.675) with wins over Alabama, Florida, and Ole Miss.

rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 record, wins over Miami and SMU, and elite FPI (27.212) and SP+ (25.6) outweigh its road loss to BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a win over Clemson and a head-to-head victory over Wake Forest, while its FPI (24.282) and SP+ (24.4) rank among the packet's best.
rationales.Texas: Texas has a 9-2 record, an FPI of 25.373, and wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, and Ole Miss, though its losses to Oklahoma and Florida temper the résumé.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 mark includes a road win over Oregon, and its SP+ of 21.1 complements a strong record despite a modest FPI of 12.581.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 résumé features wins over LSU, Florida State, and Texas A&M, with FPI 24.21 and SP+ 22.9; losses to Georgia and Tennessee keep it below the leaders.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with wins over USC, Michigan, and Nebraska and strong FPI (20.765) and SP+ (23.1), offset by losses to Ohio State and Washington.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 8-2 record includes a decisive win over Alabama and wins over Kentucky and LSU, while its FPI (19.071) and SP+ (21.5) support a top-ten placement.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon has an FPI of 21.349 and SP+ of 18.3, plus wins over Ohio State and USC, but losses to UCLA, Oklahoma State, and Illinois constrain its position.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech's 9-1 record and wins over Arizona, Houston, and Oklahoma State are strong, though its FPI (17.062), SP+ (19.4), and loss to Cincinnati trail the teams above.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with wins over Notre Dame, Arizona, and Iowa State and a strong 18.0 SP+, but the road loss to Utah and loss at UCF are meaningful blemishes.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia leads on SP+ (31.3) and FPI (28.7) with a 9-1 record, and its lone loss is a home defeat to Auburn.

rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with an SP+ of 24.4 and FPI of 24.3, with its only loss a 24-31 road defeat to Notre Dame.

rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State's 7-4 record is weaker than its SP+ (24.1) and FPI (23.2) suggest, but it has road wins over Iowa and Indiana and losses to Texas by one point and to Oregon.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon has a 7-3 record with a 41-28 road win over Ohio State and a 41-27 win at USC, while its SP+ (18.3) and FPI (21.3) are strong.

rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a 17-15 win at Oregon and SP+ of 21.1, but its strength of schedule and FPI (12.6) are less impressive than its record.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with a 23-24 road loss to Ohio State offset by wins over Tennessee and Ole Miss, and its SP+ (22.4) and FPI (25.4) are near the top.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with SP+ 21.7 and FPI 19.4, but its schedule (including Kansas and TCU) is weaker and it has no notable losses to help separate it from the group.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with SP+ 21.5 and FPI 19.1, and its wins over Alabama and Kentucky are strong, though its 17-20 home loss to Texas is a blemish.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with SP+ 19.4 and FPI 17.1, and its losses are limited to a 24-37 road defeat to Cincinnati.

rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with head-to-head wins over Houston and Arizona and a road rout of Oklahoma State, its only loss at Cincinnati.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia pairs the packet's top FPI and SP+ marks with a 9-1 record and wins over Alabama, Florida, and Ole Miss.

rationales.Utah: Utah is the only candidate without a notable loss, pairing a 10-0 record with wins over BYU, Arizona, and Cincinnati.

rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 finish, 20.765 FPI, and quality wins over Nebraska, Michigan, and USC justify a top-four placement.

rationales.Texas: Texas's 9-2 record, 25.373 FPI, and wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, and Ole Miss support an elite résumé.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 record and wins over LSU, Florida State, and Texas A&M are offset by narrow losses to Georgia and Tennessee.

rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 8-2 record and wins over Alabama, Auburn, and LSU give it a strong finish despite losses to Texas and South Carolina.

rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with head-to-head wins over Notre Dame and Arizona, though losses to Utah and UCF keep it at the AP's No. 12.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia pairs a 9-1 record with the packet's top FPI (28.675) and SP+ (31.3), including wins over Alabama and Ole Miss.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0, owns wins over BYU and Arizona, and rates strongly at 19.374 FPI and 21.7 SP+.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 record, 27.212 FPI, 25.6 SP+, and wins over Miami and SMU offset its narrow BYU loss.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with 24.4 SP+ and a road win over Wake Forest, while its only loss came at Notre Dame.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 mark includes a road win over Oregon, and its 21.1 SP+ supports a high placement despite a lower FPI and a loss to Michigan.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with 23.1 SP+ and wins over USC and Michigan, though its four-point home loss to Ohio State and Washington defeat weigh against it.
rationales.Texas: Texas has a 9-2 record, 25.373 FPI, and wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, and Ole Miss, but losses to Oklahoma and Florida temper its résumé.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 24.21 FPI and 22.9 SP+ accompany wins over LSU, Texas A&M, and Florida State, but it lost to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 18.3 SP+ and wins over Ohio State, USC, and Boise State are strong, though losses to UCLA, Illinois, and Oklahoma State leave it at 7-3.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 and beat Alabama by 16, with solid 19.071 FPI and 21.5 SP+, but lost to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with a 19.4 SP+ and wins over Arizona and Houston, while its lower 17.062 FPI and loss to Cincinnati restrain its rank.
rationales.BYU: BYU's 8-2 résumé features wins over Notre Dame, Arizona, and Iowa State, but Utah and UCF losses and its 15.318 FPI put it below the leading contenders.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia leads on SP+ (31.3) and FPI (28.7) with a 9-1 record and a win at Alabama, the best measurable resume on the board.
rationales.Miami: Miami posts top-tier SP+ (24.4) and FPI (24.3) with a 9-1 record and wins over Clemson and Florida State, backed by strong schedule ratings.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama carries SP+ 22.9 and FPI 24.2 with a road win at Kentucky and a home win over Texas A&M, though two losses (Georgia, Tennessee) temper it.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's SP+ (23.1) and FPI (20.8) rank near the top, with a 8-2 record and a win over USC, though its schedule metrics are less dominant.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State's SP+ (24.1) and FPI (23.2) are elite, offset by losses to Texas and Oregon and a 7-4 record.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's SP+ (25.6) is among the best on the board with a 10-1 record, but its only loss is to BYU and its SOS ratings trail the top tier.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 record and SP+ (21.1) reflect a strong body of work, with a road win at Oregon offset by a loss to Michigan.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten (10-0) with SP+ 21.7 and FPI 19.4, but its schedule profile and the Arizona close win keep it below the top tier on margin metrics.
rationales.Texas: Texas has SP+ 22.4 and FPI 25.4, with a win over Ohio State, but two losses (Florida, Oklahoma) limit its resume.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's SP+ (21.5) and FPI (19.1) are strong with a win over Alabama, though losses to Texas and South Carolina weigh on it.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest posts SP+ 22.6 and FPI 20.2 with a 9-1 record and wins over Louisville and SMU.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with SP+ 19.4 and FPI 17.1, with the lone loss at Cincinnati and solid wins over Arizona and Houston.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia paces the nation with a dominant 31.3 SP+ rating and an elite 28.68 FPI while posting marquee wins over Alabama and Florida.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's top-tier efficiency metrics, including 27.21 FPI and 25.6 SP+, validate an exceptional 10-1 body of work highlighted by a victory over Miami.
rationales.Texas: Texas combines a blistering 25.37 FPI with top-tier schedule metrics and decisive head-to-head wins over Tennessee and Ohio State.
rationales.Utah: Utah stands undefeated at 10-0 with a balanced 21.7 SP+ and critical resume wins over BYU and Houston.
rationales.Miami: Miami boasts a stellar 24.28 FPI and 24.4 SP+ rating, complemented by nine victories including a dominant road triumph against Wake Forest.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama pairs a formidable 24.21 FPI rating with a brutal schedule profile and a dominant road win against LSU.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's elite 23.1 SP+ and top-ten FPI profile support their strong 8-2 resume with a quality victory over USC.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee holds top-ten predictive efficiency across SP+ and FPI, backed by a convincing head-to-head win over Alabama.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA commands a 10-1 record with solid underlying metrics, anchored by a critical road victory over Oregon.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest rates tenth in predictive efficiency with a 22.6 SP+ and an outstanding 9-1 mark with eight multi-score wins.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech's 19.4 SP+ and 9-1 record feature key resume wins over Houston and Arizona.
rationales.BYU: BYU owns top-fifteen predictive grades and high-leverage victories over Notre Dame and Arizona to secure their spot.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with wins over Alabama, Ole Miss, Florida and Missouri, and its lone loss was a one-point home stumble to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated at 10-0 with head-to-head wins over BYU, Houston and Arizona plus a 43-10 rout of Arkansas.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a win over Miami and dominant victories over Wisconsin, SMU and Stanford; its only loss was a four-point road game at BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with quality wins over Notre Dame, Clemson, Florida State and Wake Forest, its only loss coming by seven on the road.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with a win over Ohio State, road wins at Tennessee and LSU, and both losses by one score.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 in the SEC with wins over LSU, Texas A&M, South Carolina, Florida State and Vanderbilt, and narrow losses to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over Alabama plus wins over Auburn, Kentucky and LSU, with close losses to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston, Arizona, Arizona State and Oklahoma State, and its only loss was at Cincinnati.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a win over Louisville and dominant road wins over SMU, Virginia and Georgia Tech.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with a win over USC and road wins at Nebraska and Michigan, with only narrow losses to Ohio State and Washington.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a win at Oregon and a road win over Wisconsin, though its schedule lacks many top-tier wins.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with a win over Notre Dame and a sweep of Arizona, Arizona State and Iowa State, but losses to Utah and UCF hold it back.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia pairs the packet's highest efficiency marks with wins over Alabama, Florida, Ole Miss, and Missouri, making its 9-1 body of work the strongest.
rationales.Texas: Texas sits at 9-2 with a 25.4 FPI, quality wins over Tennessee and Ohio State, and the strongest candidate schedule proxy at 0.5884.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 Big Ten résumé includes wins over USC, Nebraska, and Michigan, with 23.1 SP+ and a 20.8 FPI supporting a top-four case.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State benefits from the committee's Big Ten preference, a 23.2 FPI, and wins over Iowa and Indiana despite four losses.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 7-3 record includes an 0.6091 schedule proxy, wins over Ohio State and USC, and a 21.3 FPI.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with Big Ten wins over Oregon, Wisconsin, Illinois, and Maryland, though its schedule proxy is only 0.4380.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa's 8-2 Big Ten record features wins over Michigan, Wisconsin, and Illinois, and the packet's systematic Big Ten benefit supports its placement.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 résumé includes eight notable wins, a 24.3 FPI, and a 0.5709 schedule proxy despite its loss to Notre Dame.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with the packet's second-best FPI and wins over Miami, Wisconsin, Stanford, and Boston College.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with wins over Alabama, Auburn, Kentucky, and LSU, backed by a 19.1 FPI and 0.5018 schedule proxy.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 record and 24.2 FPI are elite, and its wins over LSU, Florida State, and Mississippi State outweigh narrow losses to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated at 10-0 with wins over BYU, Arizona, Cincinnati, and Arkansas, plus a 19.4 FPI and no notable losses.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia pairs a 9-1 record with wins over Alabama, Florida, Ole Miss and Oklahoma, giving it the packet's strongest blend of résumé and high-level wins.
rationales.Texas: Texas's nine wins include victories over Tennessee and Ohio State, while its only defeats came against Florida and Oklahoma.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's eight wins feature a 47-15 rout of Rutgers and a road win over Nebraska, with the Big Ten strength of schedule supporting a top-four case.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon earned Big Ten wins over Ohio State, USC and Michigan and sits at 7-3 with the highest candidate strength-of-schedule proxy.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State is 7-4 but owns wins over Iowa, Indiana and Illinois, and its Big Ten schedule justifies a playoff berth despite four losses.
rationales.Utah: Utah's 10-0 record includes wins over BYU, Arizona and Houston, making its undefeated body of work the cleanest résumé in the field.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a neutral-site win over Wisconsin and a home victory over Miami, offset only by its narrow loss at BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 record includes a road win over Wake Forest and a 45-6 victory at Stanford, with its only loss coming against Notre Dame.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 with eight notable wins, including LSU, Mississippi State and Florida State, though losses to Georgia and Tennessee limit its ceiling.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 Big Ten résumé includes wins over Oregon, Wisconsin, Maryland and Illinois, with only a narrow loss at Michigan.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa's eight wins include Michigan, Wisconsin and Illinois, and the Big Ten slate plus a 30-0 shutout of Wisconsin supports inclusion.
rationales.USC: USC's eight wins include Penn State and Ohio State, and the Big Ten schedule gives its résumé a substantial boost despite three losses.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 body of work includes wins over Alabama, Ole Miss, Oklahoma and Florida, with its only loss a narrow home upset by Auburn, and it profiles as the packet's strongest team.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated at 10-0 with wins over BYU, Houston, Arizona and Iowa State, though its schedule lacks a top-tier road scalp, so I note some uncertainty about its ceiling.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a dominant win over Miami and a 58-7 rout of Stanford, its lone blemish a narrow loss at BYU.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win at Oregon and a rout of Maryland; its only loss is a two-point defeat at Michigan, and I acknowledge its schedule is comparatively light.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with wins over Notre Dame, Clemson and Florida State, its only loss a seven-point road game at Notre Dame.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with a win over Ohio State and wins over Tennessee and Ole Miss, though losses to Oklahoma and Florida temper its profile.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with a win over USC and only narrow losses to Ohio State and Washington, keeping it firmly in the at-large conversation.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 with wins over LSU, Texas A&M and South Carolina, but losses to Georgia and Tennessee leave it behind the unbeatens and one-loss teams.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a statement win over Alabama and a road win at Georgia Tech, its losses to Texas and South Carolina both close.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with a win over Houston and a 52-27 rout of Oklahoma State, its only loss at Cincinnati.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with wins over Louisville, SMU and Virginia, its only loss to Miami.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with a win over Notre Dame and a win over Arizona, but losses to Utah and UCF keep it just outside the top ten.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's lone blemish is a three-point home loss to Auburn, offset by road wins at Alabama and Ole Miss and a neutral-site win over Florida, the strongest top-to-bottom ledger in the packet.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with wins over BYU, Houston, and Arizona, and while the schedule is thinner than the SEC contenders', an unbeaten record with those head-to-head results is decisive here.
rationales.Miami: Miami's only loss is a seven-point road defeat at Notre Dame, and its wins at Wake Forest, at Clemson, and over Duke and Florida State give it the best ACC résumé.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with its only loss at BYU by four, plus wins over Miami, Wisconsin, and SMU, though I note the schedule's lower half is soft.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win at Oregon and a narrow two-point loss at Michigan; the packet's ratings are less gaudy than the record, so I hold it just outside the top four.
rationales.Texas: Texas has wins over Tennessee, Ohio State, and Ole Miss but two losses, including a home defeat to Florida, which caps how high a 9-2 team can sit.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with head-to-head wins over Houston and Arizona and a road win at Oklahoma State, with the lone loss at Cincinnati; the Big 12 depth is thinner, so I am uncertain but rank it here.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's two losses are by a combined seven points to Ohio State and Washington, and it beat USC and Nebraska on the road, a strong but not elite profile.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame and Arizona and lost only at Utah and UCF, giving it a credible case just behind the one-loss Big Ten and ACC teams.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's losses to Georgia and Tennessee are respectable, but I weigh the road win at LSU and the Kentucky blowout as its best evidence; I am uncertain whether the committee would place it higher.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee beat Alabama and Kentucky but lost at home to Texas and on the road to South Carolina, a mixed SEC ledger.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with its only loss to Miami and wins at Louisville and SMU, though the schedule's lower tier is weak enough that I flag real uncertainty about this placement.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia looks like the nation's most dominant team, posting massive blowouts like 42-7 at Ole Miss and a 20-17 road win at Alabama.
rationales.Utah: Utah is an undefeated powerhouse showing great versatility, combining blowout margins with a gritty 40-39 road victory at Arizona.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame passes every eye test with explosive offense and defense, headlining their resume with a 31-24 triumph over Miami.
rationales.Miami: Miami has dominated opponents by wide margins all season, highlighted by a 41-13 dismantling of Clemson and a solid 33-20 road win at Wake Forest.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's explosive high gear is undeniable, demonstrated by huge road victories over LSU 31-13 and Kentucky 45-17.
rationales.Texas: Texas displays top-tier talent and physical dominance, claiming high-profile wins at Tennessee and against Ohio State.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee controls the line of scrimmage convincingly, underscored by a decisive 26-10 home victory over Alabama.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA has looked sharp and composed in key spots, including a 17-15 road win at Oregon and a 54-3 rout of Maryland.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest overwhelms competition with a prolific offense, winning five games by at least 21 points.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech scores at will with supreme offensive firepower, putting up 52 points at Oklahoma State and beating both Arizona and Houston.
rationales.BYU: BYU plays tough, physical football in marquee games, taking down Notre Dame 28-24 and Arizona 28-17.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana has looked fundamentally sound and steady, earning quality wins over USC and Michigan while remaining competitive in every contest.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 70-20 win over Western Kentucky and a 42-7 road rout of Ole Miss show dominant margins, even with a one-point loss to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten with its only close call a 40-39 road win at Arizona, and wins over BYU and Cincinnati were controlled by margin.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech won 53-25 over Arizona State and 53-48 over West Virginia while going 9-1, with its one loss a 37-24 road defeat at Cincinnati.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 52-23 win over Pittsburgh and 45-6 road rout of Stanford show explosive offense, and its only loss came in a 24-31 road defeat at Notre Dame.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's blowouts of Stanford (58-7), Boston College (41-7) and Navy (35-13), along with its 41-13 neutral win over Wisconsin, support strong winning margins despite a single close loss to BYU.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana won 52-16 over North Texas and 47-15 at Rutgers, but its two marquee results were close wins over Ohio State and Nebraska.
rationales.Texas: Texas's wins over Ohio State (24-23) and Ole Miss (34-27) are competitive, though its 24-27 home loss to Florida and 27-24 Oklahoma result keep the margins thin.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 49-18 win over South Carolina and 45-17 win at Kentucky look dominant, but its 20-17 loss to Georgia and 10-26 loss at Tennessee weigh against it.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA won 45-24 at California and 54-3 at Maryland, yet its 15-17 home loss to Oregon and 16-18 loss at Michigan leave its eye-test profile mixed.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee beat Alabama 26-10 and Kentucky 34-6, but its 6-34 loss to South Carolina is not the kind of game that matches its best wins.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest's 57-3 win over Stanford, 51-7 win over Virginia and 49-7 win at SMU are strong, but its 20-33 home loss to Miami was clearly lopsided.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State's 31-14 at Iowa and 45-16 win over Maryland look good, but its 23-24 loss at Texas and 28-41 home loss to Oregon are concerning.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia stays first with a 9-1 record, a road win over Alabama, and convincing wins over Oklahoma and Ole Miss.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0 and owns wins over BYU, Houston, and Arizona, with no loss to offset them.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 resume includes a win over Miami and strong victories over SMU and Wisconsin, though BYU beat it head-to-head.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 record features wins over Wake Forest and Clemson; its road loss at Notre Dame is outweighed by its broader resume.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 mark and road win at Oregon are substantial, while its only listed loss was a narrow one at Michigan.
rationales.Texas: Texas has wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, and Ole Miss, but the losses to Oklahoma and Florida keep it below the leading unbeaten teams.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's wins over Ohio State and USC are impressive, but losses to UCLA, Illinois, and Oklahoma State temper its 7-3 record.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 record includes wins over USC, Michigan, and Nebraska, with the close home loss to Ohio State and road loss at Washington.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Arizona and Houston, and its only loss came on the road at Cincinnati.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee has beaten Alabama and several SEC opponents, but the home loss to Texas and road loss to South Carolina matter.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a road win over Louisville and a strong victory at SMU, but lost at home to Miami.
rationales.BYU: BYU's 8-2 record includes head-to-head wins over Notre Dame and Arizona, offset by losses to Utah and UCF.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia anchors the top from the AP poll, backed by a 9-1 resume with wins over Alabama, Oklahoma, Ole Miss, and Florida and only a one-point Auburn loss.
rationales.Utah: Utah stays second as the packet's lone undefeated 10-0 team, with head-to-head wins over BYU, Houston, and Arizona validating the ranking.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame holds third on a 10-1 body of work featuring Miami, Wisconsin, SMU, and Navy wins, with the lone blemish a close loss at BYU.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA keeps its top-four slot at 10-1, with the road win at Oregon and victories over Wisconsin, Illinois, and Michigan State outweighing a narrow Michigan loss.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 ACC resume, including Clemson, Florida State, and a head-to-head win over Wake Forest, supports its top-five position.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 mark includes a win over USC and road wins at Michigan and Nebraska, with both losses (Ohio State, Washington) by one score.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama starts at seventh per the prior committee order despite the Georgia and Tennessee losses, given quality wins over LSU, Texas A&M, South Carolina, and Florida State.
rationales.Texas: Texas sits eighth at 9-2, with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, and LSU offsetting close losses to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee stays ninth at 8-2, headlined by a home win over Alabama plus Auburn, LSU, and Kentucky victories, with narrow losses to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest holds the final bye slot at 9-1, with a road win over Louisville and dominant wins over SMU, Stanford, and Virginia.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech stays at eleven as a 9-1 Big Ten/Big 12-era team with wins over Houston, Arizona, and Oklahoma State, its only loss a road stumble at Cincinnati.
rationales.BYU: BYU rounds out the projected field at 8-2, with head-to-head wins over Notre Dame and Arizona plus a Utah road loss keeping it just inside the top twelve.
